events.verdict: Replay review of the foul called on Allen (CLE) pursuant to a coach's challenge was deemed unsuccessful. Allen (CLE) initiates contact with Maxey's (PHI) lower leg, which affects his driving shot attempt.
Maxey (PHI) maintains a legal guarding position alongside Tyson's (CLE) path as he defends the shot attempt.
George (PHI) and Allen (CLE) come together in pursuit of the loose ball and marginal contact occurs during the rebound.
Oubre Jr. (PHI) makes marginal contact with Hunter's (CLE) body while defending the drive to the basket and shot attempt.
Tyson (CLE) and Maxey (PHI) briefly engage and disengage off-ball.
George (PHI) goes to, not through, Tyson's (CLE) space and the contact that occurs during the drive is marginal.
Tyson (CLE) brings his hands towards Oubre Jr. (PHI) as he releases away, and the contact during the pick is marginal.
George (PHI) maintains verticality and absorbs contact from Mitchell (CLE) as he defends his shot shot attempt.

Replay review of the foul called on Oubre Jr. (PHI) pursuant to a coach's challenge was deemed unsuccessful. Oubre Jr. (PHI) initiates contact with Mobley's (CLE) arm, which affects his driving shot attempt.
Allen (CLE) makes marginal contact with Maxey (PHI), as they come together on the perimeter.
Embiid (PHI) immediately slides his hand off of Mobley's (CLE) side and marginal contact occurs off-ball during the inbound.
Edgecombe (PHI) legally contests Mobley's (CLE) dunk attempt.
Maxey (PHI) legally contests Tyson's (CLE) jump shot attempt.
